<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Feral Toss](/Feats.aspx?ID=5506) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 79

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); your animal shape grants an antler, horn, or tusk unarmed attack

**Requirements**
You’re in hybrid or animal shape.

</column>

---

You hurl foes away with a shake of your head. You Strike with your antler, horn, or tusk. If you hit and damage a creature of your size or smaller, [push](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) it 5 feet from you (10 feet on a critical hit). This is forced movement.
